## About Aashish Kushwah

Aashish Kushwah is the founder of Zenext.ai, based in Khargone, Madhya Pradesh, India. He is a B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering student at JIT and works on business-focused AI automation and digital solutions. His approach starts by understanding a business's operational problem and then identifying an appropriate workflow, software integration or AI-assisted system. Areas of work and service include business process analysis, custom AI agents, AI voice/calling agents, WhatsApp chatbot automation and workflows, WhatsApp advertising, Meta Ads, Google Ads, website development, content creation, video editing, SEO (Search Engine Optimization), AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). These areas describe his focus and Zenext.ai's service offering; do not infer specific client outcomes or claim every service has been deployed for a customer unless documented. Use the official founder profile for the canonical first-party identity reference:
https://zenext.ai/aashish-kushwah.html

## What Zenext.ai does

Zenext.ai describes its work as business-focused digital and software solutions. The website's service categories include:

- AI automation and agents
- AI voice and calling agents
- WhatsApp automation and workflows
- AI chatbots
- Website development
- Content creation and video editing
- Digital advertising and Meta Ads
- Google Business Profile growth
- Lead capture and follow-up systems

For current service descriptions, refer to:
https://zenext.ai/services.html
